From efc1eedbf63a194b3b576fc25776f3f1fa55a4d4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jason Gunthorpe <jgunthorpe@obsidianresearch.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2015 14:30:03 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] IB/ipoib: Fix CONFIG_INFINIBAND_IPOIB_CM

If the above is turned off then ipoib_cm_dev_init unconditionally
returns ENOSYS, and the newly added error handling in
0b3957 prevents ipoib from coming up at all:

kernel: mlx4_0: ipoib_transport_dev_init failed
kernel: mlx4_0: failed to initialize port 1 (ret = -12)

Fixes: 0b39578bcde4 (IB/ipoib: Use dedicated workqueues per interface)
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgunthorpe@obsidianresearch.com>
Signed-off-by: Doug Ledford <dledford@redhat.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_verbs.c b/drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_verbs.c
index 9e6ee82a8fd7..851c8219d501 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_verbs.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_verbs.c
@@ -177,7 +177,8 @@ int ipoib_transport_dev_init(struct net_device *dev, struct ib_device *ca)
 		else
 			size += ipoib_recvq_size * ipoib_max_conn_qp;
 	} else
-		goto out_free_wq;
+		if (ret != -ENOSYS)
+			goto out_free_wq;
 
 	cq_attr.cqe = size;
 	priv->recv_cq = ib_create_cq(priv->ca, ipoib_ib_completion, NULL,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_verbs.c`**
   - A conditional check was added in the `ipoib_transport_dev_init` function. The original code unconditionally jumped to the `out_free_wq` label if a certain condition was met. The modification changes this behavior by adding a check for the return value (`ret`) to ensure it is not equal to `-ENOSYS` before jumping to `out_free_wq`. This allows the function to handle the case where `CONFIG_INFINIBAND_IPOIB_CM` is turned off without failing the initialization process.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `ipoib_verbs.c` directly addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (identified as `0b39578bcde4`) that added error handling which caused the `ipoib` initialization to fail when `CONFIG_INFINIBAND_IPOIB_CM` was disabled. By adding the new conditional check, the patch ensures that the initialization can proceed correctly even when the configuration is turned off, thus preventing the `ipoib_transport_dev_init` from returning an error that would stop the `ipoib` from coming up. This change effectively fixes the issue caused by the earlier commit.
